title: Amendment to SEBI (FII) Regulations 1995
text: Foreign Institutional Investors Division FITTC Department E- MAIL :santoshk@sebi.gov.in WEB-SITE:www.sebi.gov.in FAX NO: 00 91 22 2845776 FITTC/FII/CUST/124985/2002 December 20,2002 To Foreign Institutional Investors and Custodians of Securities Dear Sir / Madam, Sub: Amendment to SEBI (FII) Regulations 1995 Consequent upon amendment to SEBI ( Foreign Institutional Investors) Regulations, 1995 1. FII registration /renewal fees have been reduced from US$ 10,000 to US $ 5,000/. Further, documentation required to be enclosed along with FII registration/ renewal applications have also been simplified and curtailed. 2. A copy of the gazette notification published in Gazette of India no. S.O.1292 (E) dated June 10, 2002 is enclosed fore your information and records. 3. The custodian of securities is requested to bring the contents of this circular to the notice of their constituents /clients. Please acknowledge receipt Yours faithfully, Santosh Sharma Asst. General Manager -- 1 of 4 -- THE GAZETTE OF INDIA EXTRAORDINARY PART –II – SECTION 3 – SUB SECTION (ii) PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA NOTIFICATION Mumbai, the 10 th December, 2002 SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA (FOREIGN INSTITUTIONAL INVESTORS) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS, 2002 S.O No. 1292(E). In exercise of the powers conferred by section 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (15 of 1992), the Board hereby makes the following Regulations to further amend the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Foreign Institutional Investors) Regulations, 1995, namely :- 1. These Regulations may be called the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Foreign Institutional Investors) (Amendment) Regulations, 2002. 2. They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 3. In the First Schedule, in Form A, in the Annexure, for clauses (a) to (d) the follwoig shall be substituted, namely: “ (a) Certified copy of the relevant clauses or articles of the Memorandum and Articles of Association or the agreement authorizing the applicant to invest on behalf of its clients. (b) Audited financial statements and annual reports for the last one year, provided that the period covered shall not be less than twelve months. -- 2 of 4 -- (c ) A declaration by the applicant with registration number and other particulars in support of its registration or regulation by a Securities Commission or Self Regulatory Organization or any other appropriate regulatory authority with whom the applicant is registered in its home country. (d) A declaration by the applicant that it has entered into a custodian agreement with a domestic custodian together with particulars of the domestic custodian. “ 4. In the Second Schedule, in paragraph (1), for the words and figures “US $ 10,000/-“the words and figures “US $ 5,000/-“shall be substituted.
